content:
alex: quick sync — product wants a short checklist for when we can promise region affinity + soft isolation for Dedicated customers. need clear launch gates we can commit to for sales.

maria: +1. can we separate hard isolation (full tenant lanes) vs soft affinity (priority routing & score-based spillover)?

sanjay: yes. suggested gating: 1) policy DSL validators in prod, 2) capacity reservation primitives, 3) automated eviction playbook, 4) telemetry to detect noisy tenants.

julia: can we add a cost impact calc per-customer? sales keeps asking about delta vs shared pools.

alex: good call. sales asked for a per-customer estimate (p95 latency, baseline qps, 99th cost delta). we should provide a template.

ashley: throwing a rough rollout checklist: 1) spec policy semantics, 2) infra sharding prototype in staging, 3) canary with 2 customers, 4) observability dashboard (routed + fallback traces), 5) runbook + eviction automation.

maria: for the policy semantics doc: prefer simple precedence rules: explicit tenant lane > affinity hints > global default. Also a TTL for affinity so we don't leak state forever.

sanjay: TTL detail: recommend soft-affinity TTL = 12h, fallback cooldown = 30m. for hard lanes TTL = N/A (explicit contract) and requires manual deprovision.

julia: sales template: small table with columns: customer, committed GPUs, expected p50/p95, monthly commit cost delta, SLA (latency/availability), fallback behavior. i'll draft.

alex: what about failure modes? deployment/region outage -> automatic spill to compatible region/model variant.

maria: add this to the runbook: on region fail -> trigger routing reroute, notify customer, switch to reduced-SLA mode (best-effort) then rehydrate KV caches.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: staging -> canary -> prod. Note: canary requires feature-flag enablement per-customer.

ashley: experiment metric set: routing success rate, affinity hit rate, average spill latency, cost per token delta, customer error-rate delta. aim: affinity hit >= 90% and spill latency < 250ms for p95.

sanjay: open question — do we need per-tenant smoothing for batching to avoid starvation of small tenants? i think yes, implement weighted fairness in scheduler.

alex: agree. add scheduler fairness to infra tasks. also need acceptance criteria: scalability test with 10k tenants, 100k qps, validate isolation (no noisy neighbor >5% latency impact).

maria: one more: compliance ask — for Private, isolation must include network egress controls + KMS scoping. flagging to security.

julia: i'll coordinate with sales to align the canary customers and make sure contracts include rollback clauses.

alex: ok next steps: julia + ashley + sanjay to draft the spec + launch checklist by EOW. maria to raise security PR. i'll prepare a short one-pager for GTM.

maria: noted. tagging @sre for runbook review once draft is ready.

alex: thanks all. :thumbsup:
